thread.subject: Replace CallFlow with RouteDesk in the Nov 6 status update.

messages.body: Hello, I will be out of the office until Monday, November 9. For urgent matters please contact…

Hi Alex,

The RouteDesk integration failed again this morning with "invalid parameter" when the supervisors opened the queue report. I looked at the logs with Daniel and we think it is the dataset, not the app itself. The integration has been stable for three weeks, so something changed on the data side over the weekend.

What we know so far:

1. A column name changed or was removed — if the underlying cc-interaction-source dataset was recently updated (columns renamed, removed, or restructured), the SQL queries in the app would reference fields that no longer exist, causing the integration to reject the request as "invalid parameter."

2. The dataset was replaced or republished — if someone republished the dataset with a new schema, the dataset ID (cc-interaction-source) still resolves, but the field references inside the queries may no longer match.

3. A data type mismatch — for example, the app casts interaction_business_date as a DATE. If that column's type changed upstream, the cast could fail.

What to do

• Check with your data team whether the cc-interaction-source dataset was recently modified, republished, or had any schema changes (column renames, removals, type changes).
• Try refreshing the page — if it was a transient issue on the dataset service side, a retry may work.
• If the error persists, the app's SQL queries likely need to be updated to match the current dataset schema.

I'd like to have this sorted before the Nov 6 status update so we can say RouteDesk fully replaces CallFlow.
